name: Capivara Booster v2.3.2 (Rust Edition)
notes: - Driver Booster vendor fallback: when Windows Update has no newer driver, the app downloads and runs the manufacturer's official web installer directly (Intel Driver & Support Assistant, NVIDIA app, AMD Adrenalin, Realtek) with elevation, per detected device

- Cache & Junk Cleaner on read-only files: the attribute is cleared (hidden attrib -R) before removal, so previously "failed" files are now deleted; files locked by another process are reported as "in use, skipped" instead of errors

- Counter-Strike 2 detection: SteamPath from the registry comes with forward slashes and is now normalized; SteamLibrary folders on all drives (C-F) are scanned as fallback plus libraryfolders.vdf; the cs2.exe path is checked in both known layouts
- Cleaner console wording: "[Cleaner OK] ... N files cleaned, M in use skipped" (was an error line for normal in-use files)

- Driver Booster com fallback do fabricante: quando o Windows Update não tem o driver, o app baixa e executa o instalador web oficial direto (Intel DSA, NVIDIA app, AMD Adrenalin, Realtek) com elevação, conforme o dispositivo
- Limpeza de arquivos read-only: o atributo é limpo antes de remover (antes dava "erro"); arquivos travados por outro processo aparecem como "em uso, pulados"
- Detecção do Counter-Strike 2 corrigida: caminho da Steam normalizado (slashes), varredura de SteamLibrary em todas as unidades e dupla checagem do cs2.exe
